company: Univ. Pisa Centro Piaggio + IIT SoftBots
company_native: Centro di Ricerca E. Piaggio / IIT Soft Robotics for Human Cooperation and Rehabilitation
first_shown: 2019 (Alter-Ego X ~2022, ANA Avatar XPRIZE finals Nov 2022)
target_applications: hospital/home-care telepresence avatar (ALS, neurodegenerative care), physical HRI research

actuators.value: Variable Stiffness Actuators (VSA, qbmove lineage) in arms and neck — muscle-like elasticity; wheel drives

end_effector.value: Pisa/IIT SoftHand per arm: 5 fingers, 19 joints, 1 actuator (synergy underactuation), 0.29 kg, 130 mm

sensors_head.value: ZED-Mini double stereoscopic camera on 2-DoF VSA pan-tilt head; microphones + speakers

sensors_base.value: tilt sensors, accelerometers, gyroscopes (balancing), proximity sensors

compute.value: Intel NUC mini-PCs (Linux) integrated in body

software_stack.value: ROS-based research stack; teleoperation via VR headset + joysticks, semi-autonomous and autonomous modes; XPRIZE avatar interface with haptic feedback

safety_compliance.value: uncertified research; intrinsic safety via low mass + soft VSA actuation + adaptive hands

deployment_evidence.value: pilot clinical avatar study at IRCCS Maugeri Milan (Fit4MedRob/PNRR): patient welcome, pain assessment, accompaniment, clinician telepresence incl. home care; ANA Avatar XPRIZE finals Nov 2022 (team AlterEgo)

notes: SoftHand commercialized separately by spin-off qbrobotics (qb SoftHand). Arm DoF: 5 per arm in 2019 paper; Alter-Ego X may differ. Weight not published (lightweight soft design).
